apps.name: BYD Sea Lion 06
apps.localizedDescription: Компаньйон для BYD Sea Lion 06: стан авто, клімат, сидіння, камери.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added
- **BYD's «Disable self-start» is detected.** On firmware V1.4.0 BYD refuses every start of the app it did not make
  itself while the app is in its «Disable self-start» list, and a clean install puts it there: after a real reboot
  telemetry stayed down until someone opened the app (16 h on 2026-11-20). Налаштування → Фонова робота → «Запускати у
  фоні» now says whether BYD blocks the app and has a button that opens BYD's list.
- **Mobile data is moved back to the working SIM slot.** Both SIM slots show the same ICCID; when the built-in module
  (slot 1, no service) gets the subscription at boot, the app moves it back to slot 0 over ADB.

### Fixed
- The window, climate and seat helpers no longer ask `pm path` over ADB for the app's own apk, and stop logging an error
  every 8 s while ADB is down.
